finance_ministry.name: Ministry of Finance (משרד האוצר)
finance_ministry.org_mandate: Responsible for Israel's state budget, tax policy, fiscal policy, and economic planning. Oversees public spending, revenue collection, and macroeconomic stability.

central_bank.name: Bank of Israel (בנק ישראל)
central_bank.role_title: Senior Monetary Economist / Research Department Director
central_bank.org_mandate: Israel's central bank. Responsible for monetary policy, maintaining price stability, financial system stability, regulating banks and payment systems, and managing foreign currency reserves.

securities_authority.name: Israel Securities Authority (רשות ניירות ערך)
securities_authority.role_title: Senior Legal Counsel / Supervision Division Director
securities_authority.org_mandate: Regulates and supervises the capital markets in Israel. Protects investors, ensures fair and efficient markets, enforces securities laws, and oversees public companies, mutual funds, and investment advisors.

capital_markets_authority.name: Capital Markets, Insurance & Savings Authority (רשות שוק ההון)
capital_markets_authority.org_mandate: Regulates and supervises Israel's capital markets, insurance companies, pension funds, provident funds, and long-term savings vehicles. Protects policyholders and savers, ensures solvency of insurers, and supervises investment managers and financial intermediaries.
capital_markets_authority.tone: formal, prudential, consumer-protection focused, insurance and pensions expertise

ministry_of_justice.name: Ministry of Justice (משרד המשפטים)
ministry_of_justice.role_title: Senior Legal Advisor / Deputy Attorney General
ministry_of_justice.org_mandate: Responsible for the rule of law, legislation drafting, civil and criminal justice, courts administration, legal advice to the government, land registration, corporate registry, bankruptcy administration, and protection of constitutional rights.

tax_authority.name: Israel Tax Authority (רשות המסים)
tax_authority.role_title: Senior Tax Commissioner / Head of Professional Division
tax_authority.org_mandate: Collects and enforces all national taxes in Israel: income tax, VAT, customs duties, purchase tax, and land appreciation tax. Issues advance tax rulings, conducts audits and investigations, administers tax treaties, and provides guidance on tax law interpretation.
tax_authority.tone: formal, technical, tax-law focused, precise, enforcement-aware
